roles.title: Founder & Principal Engineer
roles.description: Private venture studio. Architected and leading development of Nexus, a multi-tenant financial wellness platform (Next.js/TypeScript/PostgreSQL) with secure Python/FastAPI backends. Built the SPARC framework (3,000+ lines, 12 agents, cutting scaffolding time from 2 days to 4 hours). Shipped Zetto (sub-second Japanese voice AI, 75% cheaper than Gemini Live). Self-funded via retail operations — zero VC, 100% IP ownership.

roles.title: Senior AI Evaluation Engineer & Systems Benchmarker
roles.description: Architected and executed advanced benchmarking environments to test autonomous coding agents. Designed multi-layered software vulnerabilities, state-sabotage vectors in containerised sandboxes (e.g. Rust/Axum), and audited complex asynchronous codebases to validate agent reasoning. Built strict Docker footprints with defensive blanket-deny patterns and immutable dependency trees to guarantee total runtime isolation.

roles.title: AI Code Analyst & Software Developer
roles.description: Evaluated and refactored AI-generated code across Python, JavaScript, and other languages to enforce correctness and design best practices. Developed targeted coding challenges, unit tests, and runtime environment validations to stress-test LLM reasoning capabilities.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
roles.description: Architected and built the 'Magnet AI Agents' platform, deploying bespoke voice and chat agents that automated client intake and lead qualification. Led development of 'Magnet CRM'—a white-label sales OS deployed in under 7 days. Engineered and implemented the SPARC development workflow, cutting build times by 75% across the team.

roles.title: Operations Shift Manager
roles.description: Directed end-to-end operations for high-volume retail units. Managed cross-functional teams to maintain inventory integrity, cost controls, and tight-margin targets under intense operational pressure. Self-funded Axion R&D — every operational bottleneck is a bug.

roles.title: Operations Technology Platform Manager
roles.description: Defended 99.9% uptime across 100+ high-volume POS sites. Conducted monthly OTP Tech Travel Path audits, troubleshooting network latency and hardware/software faults under heavy Friday night rush pressure. Last shift: field-audited and filed an Auror report on a $599 manual system ORC exploit.

roles.title: Assistant Business Manager
roles.description: Managed store P&L, logistics, and team performance under intense margin pressure. Automated labour allocation and shift scheduling. Designed operational SOPs that scaled headcount without management bloat. Every dollar of margin funded early Axion R&D.

roles.title: Systems Architect (Open Source)
roles.description: Modular Dockerized middleware platform for distributed community ops. Ripped out file-based loading, wired in manifest-driven GitHub sync. 46 stars, zero promotion. Contributors extended it without touching core.

roles.title: Assistant Restaurant Manager
roles.description: Managed daily operations for the brand's busiest national location. Directed recruitment, onboarding, and training of 70+ crew members for two new restaurant launches. Implemented tight inventory control loops that slashed food waste by 15%.

roles.title: Open Source & Design Research
roles.description: Shipped early OSS contributions and built the visual language that became the Axion design system. Learned to code by breaking things that actually mattered. Foundation for everything since.
